title: Reignite (RTÉ Radio One) — Eric opens Season 7 of Áine Kerr's book-club show
summary: Áine Kerr — Irish journalist and co-founder of Kinzen — opens Season 7 of Reignite on RTÉ Radio One (Ireland's national public broadcaster) with Eric on how to build organisations that ensure we aren't 'locked into another century of institutional betrayal.' Also on the show: Irish entrepreneurs Rena Maycock (Chirp) and Dee Coakley (Boundless). Aired 2026-07-25; the Reignite Book Club then follows Incorruptible for six weeks.
blockquote: On the first show we have Eric Ries of The Lean Startup fame who is back with "Incorruptible" and Steve Kamb of Nerd Fitness who has just published "How to Try Again".
attribution_title: Host, Reignite (RTÉ Radio One); co-founder, Kinzen
